newsitem.title: USA: NUI aims for double-digit earnings growth.
newsitem.headline: NUI aims for double-digit earnings growth.

text.p: NUI Corp said on Tuesday that its goal over the next few years is to continue delivering "double digit earnings growth."

President and chief executive officer John Kean Jr told shareholders at the company's annual meeting that the company will continue its core gas distribution business, while increasing margins through complimentary customer services and energy sales. The company issued a news release after the annual meeting.
NUI said its 1996 revenues of $469 million increased 16 percent from 1995 and net income in 1996 increased 38 percent to $14.9 million.
